precondition: unique ordered hline/vline iteration preserves multiplicity and source order, while interior and border coordinates use canonical gap-midpoint and frame-boundary geometry

variants.transform: draw only the first hline by replacing full iteration with first()
skip all hline emission while retaining vlines
sort and deduplicate offsets before drawing
place interior lines on the adjacent cell edge instead of the middle of the gap
skip offsets 0 and dimension while retaining interior lines

variant_killers.M23c-collapse-order: hline (2,0,2,1) and vline (1,2,1,0) emit eight lines; each axis retains four coordinates with index 0 equal to 2 and unequal to 1, proving duplicate multiplicity and source order
variant_killers.M23d-cell-edge: the sole hline/vline at offset 1 equals the independently computed midpoint between adjacent cell extents, not either cell edge

validity: All variants require their attributable public witness. M23c cannot take credit from generic line count alone, and M23d cannot derive its expected coordinate from the line implementation under test.
